name: Bitter Rivals
summary: In Dun Morogh, the Barleybrews and Thunderbrews compete for renown. Marleth Barleybrew sends you to the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos to replace a cask of Thunder Ale with her family's brew.

sections.title: A Taste of Competition
sections.body: Ale stirs fierce pride in Khaz Modan. The Barleybrews have long resented the fame of the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. Marleth Barleybrew admits that Thunderbrew makes a respectable ale, but she cannot accept that it alone is renowned in Dun Morogh. She plans to shake up the local palate by replacing a cask of Thunder Ale with her own fiery Barleybrew Scalder.

sections.title: Cellar Subterfuge
sections.body: The plan takes you into the distillery cellar, beneath the kitchen in Kharanos. Aging casks wait in the basement storeroom, and a guard watches near the Thunderbrews' most prized reserve. You need to draw him away before secretly switching the barrels.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Bitter Rivals?
faq.answer: Marleth Barleybrew gives the work. She wants her family's brewing craft to rival the renowned ale of the Thunderbrew Distillery.

faq.q: Where is the Thunderbrew cellar located?
aliases: how to get to distillery cellar
faq.answer: The cellar lies beneath the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. Its stairs are tucked behind a table in the kitchen.
Barleybrew Scalder is Marleth Barleybrew's potent house ale. She hopes that tasting it in place of Thunder Ale will make Kharanos patrons recognize her brewing skill.

faq.q: How do you bypass the guard watching the barrels?
faq.answer: The Thunderbrew guard in the basement hints at what might draw his attention away. Distract him, then you have time to switch the barrels.

faq.q: Why are the Barleybrews and Thunderbrews feuding?
faq.answer: The feud comes from dwarven pride in their craft. The Thunderbrews dominate Kharanos taverns, and the Barleybrews want to prove their recipes just as good, or better.
After placing the cask of Barleybrew Scalder, you return to Marleth to report your success.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know brewing is serious business, with prestige rivaling blacksmithing. A feud over rival ales feels at home in the snows of Dun Morogh.
As a rogue, you know how to slip into a guarded cellar, distract a sentry, and switch contraband. Here, the prize is beer instead of gold.
As an Alliance traveler, you pass through Kharanos, Dun Morogh's cultural and logistical hub, where local inn disputes often draw in recruits.
